title: Strong Convergence of FISTA for Affinely Constrained Convex Quadratic Minimization
summary: In October 2025, research by Boţ, Fadili, and Nguyen, and by Jang and Ryu, led to the seminal result that Beck and Teboulle's FISTA converges weakly to a minimizer of the sum of two convex functions resolving a long-standing open problem. The first strong convergence result was obtained in November 2025 by Moursi, Naguib, Pavlovic, and Vavasis for affinely constrained convex minimization provided certain closedness conditions hold. In this paper, we prove strong convergence in the affine-quadratic case without any closedness assumption. Specializing this to the unconstrained case, we obtain…
